sql: SELECT json_build_object('conv', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', c.id, 'bot_step', c.bot_step, 'bot_enabled', c.bot_enabled, 'handoff', c.bot_data->'ai_handoff', 'unit', i.unit)) FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE c.contact_phone LIKE '%15997300027%'), 'msgs', (SELECT json_agg(m ORDER BY m.timestamp) FROM (SELECT m.timestamp, m.from_me, m.message_type, m.status, m.metadata->>'source' AS src, left(m.content, 120) AS txt, left(m.media_url, 60) AS media FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.contact_phone LIKE '%15997300027%' ORDER BY m.timestamp LIMIT 40) m)) AS r
